Product Features

  • This sideboard measures 150 × 40 × 75 cm and impresses with its versatile colour scheme in white and warm wood tones. Made of high-quality MDF panels, it is ideal for living and dining rooms as well as a sofa sideboard thanks to its robust and stable construction and blends harmoniously into various furnishing styles such as modern and Scandinavian.
  • The sideboard features a handleless, spacious drawer design that provides a clean and tidy appearance. It dispenses with the clutter and distracting look of traditional handles, giving the sideboard a minimalist and elegant appearance. At the same time, the risk of impact is minimized and safety is increased, which makes it particularly suitable for families with children.
  • Equipped with six drawers and double doors, the sideboard offers a clear and logical storage option. The drawers can be used to store crockery, small items and textiles, while the cupboard doors offer space for decorative items or larger items. Thus, it offers a complete solution for your storage needs in the dining and living room.
  • The cabinet doors are made of translucent acrylic and combine aesthetics and functionality. They present the stored items clearly and at the same time effectively prevent dust accumulation. This makes the cabinet doors appear less solid and elegant, which enhances the overall effect of the room.
  • The cabinet doors are equipped with high-quality damping hinges that reduce vibration when opening and closing, ensuring smooth and quiet operation. Door noise is avoided, wear and tear on components is reduced and the service life of the cabinet is significantly extended. This ensures a comfortable and enjoyable user experience.
  • The raised base of the cabinet allows robot vacuums to easily reach the bottom of the cabinet and clean it thoroughly without reaching hard-to-reach places. At the same time, the room looks larger and more open.
  • Built-in, soft LED light strips provide an even, glare-free light and thus create a warm atmosphere. At the same time, they illuminate the objects in the cabinet and thus make it easier to find.
  • MDF boards with environmentally friendly surface treatment are wear-resistant, scratch-resistant and dimensionally stable. The surface is smooth and easy to clean; everyday stains can be easily removed with a damp cloth. The color combination of white and wood is durable and appealing, and it looks like new even after long use.
  • NOTE: This product consists of two packages and may not arrive at the same time. Please make sure both packages have arrived before you start assembling!
  • Note: Due to different shooting conditions and display devices, there may be slight color variations between the actual product and the image. This is normal and not a quality defect. We strive to display the product color as faithfully as possible. Please only order if this is important to you.

Descriptions

This multifunctional sideboard (150 × 40 × 75 cm) impresses with its elegant design in white and wood look and is made of high-quality MDF. It features double doors and six drawers, acrylic doors, spacious handleless drawers, noise-absorbing hinges, a tall frame, and LED light strips. It offers plenty of storage space for living and dining rooms and can also be used as a sofa sideboard. It combines aesthetics, functionality, quiet operation, easy cleaning and an atmospheric ambience.
